tools.name: educateme_list_courses
tools.description: List the courses in the workspace with their finished and suspended state and course URLs. Optionally filter by learner email. Start here to find a course id. GET /courses.

tools.name: educateme_list_course_activities
tools.description: List the activities (lessons, webinars, quizzes, assignments, certificates) of one course, in course order, with type, draft state, module and link. GET /courses/{id}/activities.

tools.name: educateme_list_course_schedules
tools.description: List scheduled content openings and live meetings (webinars) of one course for a date range, with join links and the activity each belongs to. GET /courses/{courseId}/schedules.

tools.name: educateme_get_course_scores
tools.description: Get the score matrix of one course: every scored activity as a column and each learner as a row with per-activity results and completion. Needs a key with workspace-admin scope. The full matrix comes back without pagination, so filter when the course is large. GET /courses/{id}/scores.

tools.name: educateme_list_course_transcripts
tools.description: List the AI transcripts and summaries of the videos of one course, with timed transcript lines. Optionally only one activity's video. GET /courses/{id}/transcripts.

tools.name: educateme_list_users
tools.description: List users of the workspace (learners, admins, mentors) with roles, suspension state, enrolled courses and instructed courses. Paginated: 10 per page by default. GET /users.

tools.name: educateme_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags of the workspace, optionally by category (ROLE, DEPARTMENT, TEAM, LOCATION, OTHER, FUNCTION, UNIT, PROBATION). GET /tags.

tools.name: educateme_list_learner_assignments
tools.description: List the homework assignments of one course: to-do items and items with a status (REDO, IN_PROGRESS, NEEDS_TO_BE_APPROVED, DONE), with deadlines and the learner. GET /courses/{courseId}/students-assignments.

tools.name: educateme_list_learner_submissions
tools.description: List assignment submissions of one course: learner answer, grade, messages with instructors, attached files and status. Filter by status, learner, or activity. GET /courses/{id}/assignments-submissions.

tools.name: educateme_export_feedback_notes
tools.description: Export written feedback notes for courses in a period, with value, activity or event title, and author (null when anonymous). GET /courses/feedback.

tools.name: educateme_export_feedback_reactions
tools.description: Count the feedback reactions (5 emoji scores, reaction_0 to reaction_4) for courses in a period. GET /courses/feedback_reactions.

tools.name: educateme_get_activity_log
tools.description: Get recent workspace events: enrollments, completions, invitations, assignment status changes, scheduled and attended events. Each event has a ready-to-show text line. Needs a key with workspace-admin scope. Paginated: 50 per page by default. GET /activity-log.

tools.name: educateme_create_tag
tools.description: Create a tag in the workspace. POST /tags.

tools.name: educateme_update_user
tools.description: Change one user: new email, tags to add or remove by name, and custom profile fields. Only the fields you pass change. POST /users/{email}.

tools.name: educateme_invite_learner_to_course
tools.description: Invite a learner by email to one course. Set without_confirmation to skip the email confirmation step. POST /courses/{courseId}/students.

tools.name: educateme_invite_learner_to_courses
tools.description: Invite one learner to several courses at once, with optional tags and custom profile fields. POST /courses/invite.

tools.name: educateme_set_learner_suspended
tools.description: Set a learner's suspension state for the whole workspace. Suspended learners cannot sign in. POST /students/{email}.

tools.name: educateme_remove_learner_from_course
tools.description: Unassign a learner from one course. The learner keeps the account and other courses. POST /courses/{courseId}/students/unassign.

tools.name: educateme_create_course
tools.description: Create a cohort-based or self-paced course, optionally copying the structure of another course and adding instructors by email. POST /courses.

tools.name: educateme_create_activity
tools.description: Create an activity in a course module: content, webinar, quiz, assignment, peer review, form or certificate. Set is_draft to true to keep it hidden from learners. POST /activities.

tools.name: educateme_update_activity
tools.description: Change an activity's title, HTML content or draft state. POST /activities/{activityId}/update.

tools.name: educateme_schedule_course_events
tools.description: Schedule webinar events for activities of a course, with start and end times in UTC. Zoom events need a Zoom account email, or set a custom webinar room link. POST /courses/{courseId}/schedule-events.

tools.name: educateme_update_course_events
tools.description: Move or change already scheduled events of a course: new start or end date, or new Zoom alternative hosts. Only the fields you pass change. PATCH /courses/{courseId}/schedule-events.

tools.name: educateme_submit_assignment
tools.description: Create an assignment activity in a course module on behalf of a learner, with title, content and type ASSIGNMENT. POST /assignments/submit.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "educateme_create_activity" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: educateme_list_courses, educateme_list_course_transcripts, educateme_list_learner_submissions · Private data: educateme_list_learner_submissions · Public sink: educateme_list_courses, educateme_create_tag, educateme_update_user, educateme_invite_learner_to_course, educateme_invite_learner_to_courses, educateme_set_learner_suspended, educateme_remove_learner_from_course, educateme_create_course, educateme_create_activity, educateme_update_activity, educateme_schedule_course_events, educateme_submit_assignment · Destructive: educateme_update_user, educateme_remove_learner_from_course.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: educateme_list_courses, educateme_list_course_transcripts, educateme_list_learner_submissions · Private data: educateme_list_learner_submissions · Public sink: educateme_list_courses, educateme_create_tag, educateme_update_user, educateme_invite_learner_to_course, educateme_invite_learner_to_courses, educateme_set_learner_suspended, educateme_remove_learner_from_course, educateme_create_course, educateme_create_activity, educateme_update_activity, educateme_schedule_course_events, educateme_submit_assignment · Destructive: educateme_update_user, educateme_remove_learner_from_course

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
